recent: Hellebuyck (suspension) is not listed on the Winnipeg Jets' official roster, per the NHL media site Friday.
Larkin (upper body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Friday, per the NHL media site.
Englund (not injury related) has been removed from the non-roster list Friday, per the NHL media site.
Head coach Lindy Ruff said Friday that Zellweger (concussion) has been cleared to play ahead of Saturday's game against the Chicago Blackhawks, Heather Engel of NHL.com reports.
Kuzmenko (personal) has been removed from the non-roster list ahead of Saturday's matchup with Montreal, per the NHL media site.
